# Draft provenance request — not sent
Subject: CodeMirage provenance mapping for paired code evaluation

Dear CodeMirage authors,

We are evaluating a paired task that receives a human source and a candidate and tests whether the candidate is its LLM paraphrase. In the public release at revision 174c25ffa9e9f218f8526d403b3aba9631dcfc43, we found code, language, source and variant, but no row-level ancestry mapping.

Could you provide a versioned mapping from each generated/paraphrased candidate to its direct parent and ultimate human source, preferably with stable IDs and exact-code hashes? We would also appreciate clarification on whether any paraphrases were produced directly from human code, or whether all paraphrases use generated-code parents, and how omitted/failed generations affect row correspondence.

We would retain your attribution and would appreciate guidance on permitted research preprocessing and redistribution of derived metadata under the stated dataset licence. We do not assume that row ordering encodes provenance.

Thank you.

No message has been sent. A response containing a mapping still requires hash, coverage, task-semantics and licensing review.
